## Contribution rules for microsoft/agent-framework

- For non-trivial changes, open or find an issue and agree on the approach first. (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L119)
- Disclose AI assistance in the PR description. (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/blob/HEAD/AI_CONTRIBUTIONS.md#L27)
- Tick the AI-usage checkbox in the PR template (exactly one option). (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L236)
- A human must write replies to review comments; do not generate or post them. (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/blob/HEAD/AI_CONTRIBUTIONS.md#L44)
- Run the tests locally before opening or updating the PR. (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/blob/HEAD/AI_CONTRIBUTIONS.md#L58)
- Be able to explain every line of the change yourself. (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/blob/HEAD/AI_CONTRIBUTIONS.md#L44)
- Keep PRs small and focused; split large AI-generated changes. (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/blob/HEAD/AI_CONTRIBUTIONS.md#L97)
- Review and verify AI output yourself before asking for review. (https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/blob/HEAD/AI_CONTRIBUTIONS.md#L42)
